findings.title: Food protection during storage, prepartion, display, service, transportation
findings.citation_text:
750.120 - Uncovered cup of yellow liquid was observed in the beer cooler. Casey's manager stated it appeared to be sweet and sour. The liquid was discarded. 
Foods shall be protected at all times. Provide covers on cups and other containers used for storage of beverages and mixers. Make sure containers and cups are also labeled as to the contents.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment:
750.800b - The following food contact surfaces were soiled:
A) inside holder for soda gun (mold/buildup);  and
B) inside ice bin (debris).

Clean and sanitize the aforementioned items prior to the next use. Also, clean and sanitize the aforementioned items as needed, and maintain them clean to eliminate buildup of debris and prevent cross contamination.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
750.800e - The following non-food contact surfaces were soiled:
A) bottom inside keg cooler (moisture/general buildup);  and
B) beer cooler - bottom inside (moisture/general buildup) & around door seals (general debris).

Clean non-food contact surfaces as needed to eliminate buildup of debris.

findings.title: Sewage and waste water disposed properly
findings.citation_text:
750.1050 - A metal beer bucket full of moldy waste water was observed inside the keg cooler. Waste water was discarded during the inspection by Casey's manager.
NOTE: Empty the bucket used to catch waste water from the keg cooler drain line at the end of every event.

All water containing sewage shall be disposed of  properly either by a public sewage system or an approved private disposal system which is constructed and operated in conformance with applicable State and local laws, ordinances and regulations.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.comment:
REPEAT 750.1220 - Floor at banquet room bar was soiled with general buildup of soil and debris under the keg cooler and under the bar counter, ice bin, and soda syrup boxes. Clean the floor as needed, and maintain it clean.

Floors shall be maintained clean.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.citation_text:
750.690 - A) White chest freezer was observed with heavy ice accumulation inside. Defrost the chest freezer.

B) Cabinet below banquet room bar handsink was in disrepair. It appeared to have potential water damage (cracking on the surface and leaning down to the floor in the back), and the right door was missing some wood. Repair the cabinet below the banquet room bar handsink.
NOTE: Make other repairs to drawers and cabinets in the bar area if needed also.

Non-food contact surfaces shall be designed and fabricated to be smooth, washable, free from unnecessary ledges, projections, or crevices and readily accessible for cleaning, and shall be of such material and in such repair as to be easily maintained in a clean and sanitary condition.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment: 750-800(b) The soda gun and the nozzle are observed soiled with syrup build-up. Also, the drainline is beginning to get moldy. To prevent cross contamination, kitchenware and food contact surfaces of equipment shall be washed, rinsed, and sanitized after each use.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.comment: 750-1200 Floors are much cleaner than observed during the last inspection. Keep the floor under the fryers routinely scrubbed so surfaces is maintained clean. Coving around the bar handsink is peeling. See notes regarding the Casey's kitchen coving too.  The junctures between walls and floors shall be coved and sealed, or shall not present an opening of more that 1/32 of an inch.
